verdict.rationale: The pack confirms that third-party tax software can transmit to ELSTER, which implies an integration channel. It never documents a public API that a user or agent can call, and the only reference to the ERiC developer channel is a probe whose connection to the artifact host timed out. Third-party software support is adjacent, not a documented API of the product itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
